say:3:1026224001:1.source_cn: 漫漫，奥萝菈小姐的情况怎么样？

say:4:1026224002:1.text: Not good... The Hypofiends seriously wounded her.
say:4:1026224002:1.source_cn: 不太好……她身上有被魔物重伤的痕迹。

say:5:1026224003:1.text: Lucky for us, her powers come from the world of dreams. She only needs sleep to recover.
say:5:1026224003:1.source_cn: 幸运的是，她的力量来源于梦境，所以只需要睡眠就可以逐渐恢复。

say:6:1026224004:1.text: Really? That's amazing. How long will it take?
say:6:1026224004:1.source_cn: 只靠睡觉就能恢复吗？需要多长时间啊？

say:7:1026224005:1.text: This could take quite a while... She's badly hurt, after all.
say:7:1026224005:1.source_cn: 这个……可能需要很久，毕竟她受的伤很重……

choice_prompt:8:1026224005.text: This could take quite a while... She's badly hurt, after all.

say:10:1026224007:1.text: Magister Merlin, you mentioned that when Aurora fell into a coma, streams of light erupted from her. They were <style="highlight">dream feathers</style>, infused with scattered magic.
say:10:1026224007:1.source_cn: 梅林你刚才说过，奥萝菈小姐陷入沉睡的时候，从她的身上飞...
say:10:1026224007:1.male: Magister Merlin, you mentioned that when Aurora fell into a coma, streams of light erupted from her. They were <style="highlight">dream feathers</style>, infused with scattered magic.
say:10:1026224007:1.female: Magister Merlin, you mentioned that when Aurora fell into a coma, streams of light erupted from her. They were <style="highlight">dream feathers</style>, infused with scattered magic.

say:11:1026224008:1.text: If we gather all the feathers and help Aurora rebuild her dream, she should wake up.
say:11:1026224008:1.source_cn: 如果能将梦境羽毛全部收集起来，帮助奥萝菈小姐复原梦境，...

say:12:1026224009:1.text: Aurora, like all of us here, is an important ally of Avalon.
say:12:1026224009:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，奥萝菈小姐和我们一样，是阿瓦隆重要的伙伴。
say:12:1026224009:1.male: Aurora, like all of us here, is an important ally of Avalon.
say:12:1026224009:1.female: Aurora, like all of us here, is an important ally of Avalon.
